@CurrentMain.DiscoveredCompactObject.recover_sound : ∀ {n : ℕ} (artifact : ByteArray) (position : ℕ)
  (update coefficients : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n)
  (r : CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.CheckedEntry n),
  CurrentMain.DiscoveredCompactObject.recover n artifact position update coefficients = some r →
    (∃ tokens keys text dictionary entries,
        ∃ (hi : position < entries.length),
          CurrentMain.QuoteTokenScan.Regions artifact.data.toList tokens ∧
            CurrentMain.DiscoveredCompactObject.decodeKeys tokens = some keys ∧
              String.fromUTF8? artifact = some text ∧
                Lean.Json.parse text = Except.ok dictionary ∧
                  List.map CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.Entry.key entries = keys ∧
                    position < keys.length ∧
                      (∀ entry ∈ entries,
                          ∃ raw,
                            dictionary.getObjVal? entry.key = Except.ok raw ∧
                              CurrentMain.StrictJsonValueBridge.reencode 2
                                    (CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.vectorValue entry.columns) =
                                  raw ∧
                                ∀ (j : Fin n),
                                  CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.columnFunction entry.columns j < 2 ^ n) ∧
                        CurrentMain.HexObjectLayout.checkKeys (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.fields entries) = true ∧
                          artifact.data =
                              (CurrentMain.HexObjectLayout.encode
                                  (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.fields entries)).data ∧
                            r.columns = (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.selected entries ⟨position, hi⟩).columns ∧
                              CurrentMain.KeyOnlyCompactObject.recover n artifact keys position update coefficients =
                                some r) ∧
      CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.columnOperator r.columns =
          ↑(CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.checkedEquiv ↑r.certificate ⋯) ∧
        (∀ (x : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n),
            CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.inverseAddress (↑r.certificate)
                ((CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.columnOperator r.columns) x) =
              x) ∧
          ∀ (x : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n),
            (CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.columnOperator r.columns)
                (CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.inverseAddress (↑r.certificate) x) =
              x
@CurrentMain.DiscoveredCompactObject.recover_complete : ∀ {n : ℕ} (artifact : ByteArray) (dictionary : Lean.Json)
  (entries : List (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.Entry n)) (i : Fin entries.length)
  (c : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Candidate n) (h : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.check c = true)
  (hc :
    c.columns =
      CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.columnFunction
        (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.selected entries i).columns),
  (∀ entry ∈ entries,
      CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.dictionaryColumns n dictionary entry.key = some entry.columns) →
    CurrentMain.HexObjectLayout.checkKeys (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.fields entries) = true →
      artifact.data = (CurrentMain.HexObjectLayout.encode (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.fields entries)).data →
        CurrentMain.DiscoveredCompactObject.decodeKeys
              (List.map (fun e => CurrentMain.HexObjectLayout.keyBytes e.key) entries) =
            some (List.map CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.Entry.key entries) →
          CurrentMain.ByteJsonGlobalCall.parseBytes artifact = Except.ok dictionary →
            CurrentMain.ByteJsonGlobalCall.parseBytes
                  (CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.payload
                    (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.selected entries i).columns) =
                Except.ok
                  (CurrentMain.StrictJsonValueBridge.reencode 2
                    (CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.vectorValue
                      (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.selected entries i).columns)) →
              CurrentMain.DiscoveredCompactObject.recover n artifact (↑i) c.updateVector c.coefficients =
                some
                  { columns := (CurrentMain.CheckedCompactObject.selected entries i).columns, certificate := ⟨c, h⟩,
                    column_match := ⋯ }
